THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 19 · Temple of Dumathoin
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Six cracked pillars frame a hall swept clean of rubble. At the far end, a seated dwarf carved from stone watches over a rough camp. Bedrolls, packs, and a paper-covered table show that this shrine has become someone’s headquarters.

The figures and stonework draw your eye to different parts of the room. You can note where everyone stands and which route remains behind you before answering. The distance between you and anyone present is something to consider while there is still time to speak.

Ask the players

Did the occupants hear you coming? Do you announce yourselves, stay concealed, parley, or enter ready to fight?
